Come Together: A Tribute to the Beatles

A celebration of the band that changed music forever.

Come Together: The Beatles Concert Experience is more than a tribute — it’s the closest you’ll come to seeing the Fab Four live on stage. This powerhouse production recreates the look, sound, and spirit of The Beatles with stunning authenticity, taking audiences on a thrilling journey through the moments that defined a generation.
 
From the explosive energy of the British Invasion to the groundbreaking studio years, you’ll relive every era — complete with era‑perfect costumes, meticulous musicianship, and the soaring vocal harmonies that shaped the soundtrack of the ’60s and ’70s. Highlights include the Sgt. Pepper years, the rooftop‑style finale, and a heartfelt salute to John Lennon.
 
Featuring over 35 of the greatest Beatles songs ever recorded, including favorites like “She Loves You,” “All My Loving,” “I Want to Hold Your Hand,” “I Saw Her Standing There,” and many more, this show delivers hit after hit in a spectacular live concert setting.
 
Performed by some of the world’s most acclaimed Beatles tribute artists, Come Together has dazzled audiences nationwide with its passion, precision, and pure joy.
Experience the magic. Experience the memories. Experience The Beatles — live on stage.
 
"An incredible show that rivals its competitors for sonic realism and visceral excitement."

 - Los Angeles Times
